accepted_scope: On every finite pure positive balanced rational embedded polyhedral space, every finite-valued function satisfying the printed rational-endpoint PCC inequalities has a unique continuous dominating completion agreeing on the rational locus, equal to its neighborhood upper semicontinuous hull and least continuous majorant; no local bound or continuity premise is assumed. The completion satisfies all real-endpoint PCCs on every witnessing rational structure. Every bounded continuous obstacle and continuous PC reference yields an actual unrestricted envelope that is continuous and nonexpansive, including nonseparable product obstacles. Sharp fan-vertex criteria and an unbalanced nonvertex jump diagnose the scope. Separately specified compact rational integral-affine balanced charts give componentwise constant envelopes; finite bounded rational carrying decompositions give literal rational PA or separately real PA endpoints, with genuine raw positive-dimensional MA and contact zero; dimension zero retains its weighted zero-fold cycle. The entire printed relative PC class has an exact half-unit obstruction to both PA density classes. No general PA regularization, general continuous-envelope raw MA, contact classification, or full original closure is asserted.
residual_original_scope: Global PA approximation in each fixed coefficient category; regularizable operator domains and continuity; necessary and sufficient raw contact conditions; reference-compatible global realization and full original P05.1/P05.2 structural classifications remain open.
